name: epicTrailer
title: Epic Trailer
description: Monumental dark obsidian titanium, molten amber forge glows, volcanic ember particles, slow thunderous pushes, and cinematic blockbuster impact.
do: Build tension with massive scale contrast and deliberate monumental pacing
Ignite metallic edges with fiery molten amber rim lighting and flares
Drift hot atmospheric ember particles through the camera foreground
dont: Do not use bouncy cartoon physics or frivolous casual fonts
Avoid flat, washed out, low-contrast ambient backgrounds
Never rush scene transitions before the visual weight registers
